gen-gf-unkempt-gf-gantari: Gantari reads like bent wire, friendly and current, with wide openings that keep every c plainly distinct from an o. Unkempt shouts above it, expressive and bold.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-gruppo: Gruppo looks tidy and clean, its curves ending well away from each other, with none of the calligraphic thinning Unkempt also skips. Unkempt does its loudest work up top.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-host-grotesk: Contemporary and understated, Host Grotesk sweeps its curves open instead of curling them shut, while Unkempt gives every stroke a pipe-like body. Side by side, one swaggers and the other simply talks.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: Approachable from the first line, Unkempt cuts its glyphs like strips of equal width and carries a commanding, expressive streak. IBM Plex Sans Arabic follows with open apertures that stay easily readable.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew reads as contemporary and friendly, with uncrowded mouths on its s and c. And Unkempt marches overhead with identical bar thickness across each line, loud against that openness.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Professional yet friendly, IBM Plex Sans JP ends each curve in a clean, open gap. Over a longer stretch that tidy openness keeps the text moving, while Unkempt, with no calligraphic thinning, stays a headline voice.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-trispace: Trispace spreads its sparse, widely set letters out with quiet confidence. Sniglet's strokes look like bent steel rod and make it the louder voice, while Trispace is the one whose curves open outward for steady, unfussy text.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Clean and neutral, Tsukimi Rounded draws round forms like open parentheses with parallel stroke edges. But Sniglet is the one built to announce, its level beat and distinctive terminals made for headlines, while Tsukimi handles the text.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-urbanist: Sniglet leads with a quiet, level beat and no weight accents. Urbanist follows with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, and a heading around twice its size gives the pair a clear step.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-varela: Round, friendly and level-headed. Varela's t shares one width between crossbar and stem, and its c opens like a wide mouth, which sets it nicely against Sniglet's distinctive, commanding display shapes.
